title: Door panel rattles and armrest features
summary: Feedback centers on door-panel rattles and buzzing noises, with a few comments about rear-door screens, armrest features, and door storage or controls.

positive.summary: Positive feedback praises the rear door panels' integrated digital screens.

negative.summary: Negative feedback focuses on squeak, rattle, and buzzing noises from door panels or nearby interior areas, with one complaint about missing heated door-panel armrests.

mixed.summary: The mixed feedback mentions a rattling or cracking-like noise from the sunroof area rather than clearly from the door panels, so the topical fit is limited.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined feedback includes repair notes about loose front door touch-box panels and questions or observations about door pulls, armrest touchscreens, and storage-pocket size without clear sentiment.

limitations: Several examples are only loosely related to door panels and include broader interior rattles or a sunroof noise.
Some fragments are repair or location notes without enough context to confirm customer sentiment.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G70 feedback on this topic.
